dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Hmm? Ah, no need for surprise, citizen. As you see, I am a musician elevated by the Sebastos, yet I am a citizen, just as you are.

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Marcia Gordiana Semproniana am I, here by the eminent will of Dominus Boethius to take over from my colleague, Xavierius, and tune the melodies of this land.
